name: Brittany Pettersen
stance: Calls for commonsense AI guardrails including independent audits, agency oversight capacity and a bar on deploying AI that fails safety checks, citing whistleblower warnings.

statements.text: I'm excited to work with @HouseDemocrats AI Commission to create smart, modern guardrails that will protect us all as we harness this technology for the future.
Congress must start the real work of putting up commonsense guardrails to avoid the worst outcomes these whistleblower are warning us of.
That starts with independent audits, making sure federal agencies have the funding & expertise to oversee these systems, and ensuring any AI that fails safety checks cannot be deployed in the U.S.
